svg.title: P23: Layered permission and sandbox collaboration and interaction

text.tspan: Primitive · A² A2 · layered role collaboration
Combine policy decisions with execution isolation.
A tool action is evaluated by policy and executed
A privileged operation or command is dispatched.
The effective capability equals the authorized
enforcement fails closed or asks for
A policy decision cannot be bypassed by
1 request(approval) → 2 select(profile) → 3 enforce(profile) → 4 return(result) → 5 record(action) → 6 report(denial_or_error)
Evidence: 40/41 repositories, 36/36 families; 40 trajectories (19 multi-checkpoint); exact audit: not sampled.
Variation: OS sandbox, container, mount policy, network rules, and approval mode.
Negative control: A prompt warning without execution enforcement is not a sandbox.
